question: Does adding a fixed set of verified NIL examples improve parsing and correctness?
control: Byte-identical frozen prompt, including the pre-existing generic copy-file example.
treatment: The unchanged control plus task statement and full NIL source of four selected examples, inserted immediately before the evaluated task. No example fixtures or expected outputs.

selection.population: Original authored corpus tasks, supported and adaptation_overlap=false; no external or new algorithm task sampling.

exclusion_reasons.ascii_lower: Reverse-case variant of evaluated ascii_upper; exclude a near-solution.
exclusion_reasons.copy_file: Already present in the control; no new worked exposure.

selection.rule: Within each category choose the lexicographically first eligible task whose intrinsic names all occur in the frozen NIL reference. Apply once, globally, before inference; no per-task selection.
selection.rationale: Cover checked byte updates, numeric buffer state, scalar conditionals and formatted sequence accumulation without evaluated solutions or new capabilities absent from the reference.

python: Rerun unchanged Python once per model/task/seed alongside NIL control; common baseline, not duplicated for an identical treatment prompt.
schedule: For each model in frozen order, run the original NIL/Python control matrix, then the NIL-only fewshot matrix. Models sequential; no smoke trials, prompt tuning or retries.
fixed: Frozen model digests, all four task contracts and oracles, seeds17/29/43, temperature0.2, context8192, three attempts,512 output/request,1536 output/trial, parser extraction, repair feedback, reference100000 steps/depth256 and nativeO0/O2 remain unchanged.
accounting: Provider prompt_eval_count and eval_count, all attempts including repairs; TCR-out=all output/solves, TCR-total=(all input+all output)/solves, undefined at zero solves.
failure_modes: Per attempt, cumulative parse/typecheck/native compile passes, mutually exclusive parse/type/backend/semantic-or-execution/timeout/infrastructure/correct outcomes. Unknown remains unknown. Also final-trial modes.
confidence: Four authored tasks, three paired seeds, two small quantized models, one rule. No causal claim about training or all familiarity; changed prompt length/content and serial condition order remain limitations.
stop_policy: Digest/preflight mismatch aborts before inference. Infrastructure failure remains recorded, not automatically retried. No substitution or invented counts; mock results are labelled synthetic.
raw_outputs: External fresh directory; retain exact requests, responses, candidates, per-attempt usage, frozen source hashes and model/server metadata.
